Short answers are welcome. Share only fictional/generalized candidate details and clean public job links. Keep your CV, exact address, private search files and account information private.

- Package version and app/operating system:
- Was setup easy? Where did you get stuck?
- Were the first questions useful? Did anything repeat or assume facts?
- One good match and why it fit:
- One poor match and why it missed:
- Did the search respect your work/location/time limits?
- Any duplicate, closed or incorrectly verified jobs?
- Did a repeat search resume usefully?
- Which sources were accessible or blocked?
- The one improvement that would help most:

Leave anything you did not try blank or mark it "not tested". Submitting this issue makes the content public.
